title: Post-Apocalyptic Mall dream
content: I've recently learned of the term MallWorld after years of having dreams in what I called my "Dream Universe." A couple of months ago I had a super interesting and shocking dream where I didn't just land in my normal world, but in fact the post-apocalyptic version. The inside of the mall was completely deserted and trashed and I quickly came into contact with some masked "soldiers" who I attempted to flee from, but was eventually caught and brought to a place where a group of people were being held hostage. I was able to sneak away at some point by exiting a futuristic sliding door that lead to the outside of the building. This was when I realized that I was in a post-apocalyptic version of my world because normally from the outside of the mall I could see the amusement park and city surrounding it, but that was all gone. The sky was an orange-red and there was dust everywhere, the mall was destroyed in parts with gaping holes and exposed rebar and cement. At this point I started to be pursued again and made a narrow escape only from knowing the mall layout like the back of my hand, but it was so weird seeing everything run down and abandoned. I eventually made it back to the hostages and was able to sneak them away before the bad guys noticed and came after me again. I'm still not sure if I made it out of that situation or not as I woke up during it. Ever since this dream, I can't look at the mall the same anymore especially on the outside, I keep getting flashes of destruction. It wasn't necessarily a scary dream to experience, as I was more curious to know how it came to be like that and how far in the future it really was. I'm wondering if anyone else has experienced something like this too and what you thought of it or if I am just going through a life crisis.
